# Rule 5 - No Bigotry
Bigotry, such as real life slurs — including ones such as "r*tard" — are not allowed. The specific weight and intention of slurs will be treated as they are understood in English, as per [textlink="Rule 7" link="RuleEnglish"]. [bold]We have zero tolerance for bigotry. You will be permanently banned for breaking this rule.[/bold]
In-character speciesism is allowed [bold]ONLY[/bold] as long as it is not directly referencing a real life slur, [textlink="and it allows anyone to escalate to killing the speciesist" link="RuleEscalate"].
## Precedents
- This includes the use of “wireback,” as that is a reference to a slur used in real life. - Calling an IPC clanker is fine. Saying "My clanka" is not, as you are now referencing a real life slur. - The classic SS13 lizard slur is an [bold]absolute[/bold] no. You cannot take the [italic]N-word[/italic] and just replace the N with an L.
